summary: SOFI ~$15.90 (about +9% premarket/early). Q3 2026 results beat: adjusted net revenue $1.37bn (+44% y/y) vs ~$1.25bn expected, adjusted EBITDA $470m (+70%), 1.2m new members, record $16.9bn originations; 2026 revenue guidance raised to $5.04bn and a 2027 outlook of $6.4bn introduced. Risk: history of fading after earnings pops.
